operational_kpis.name: Rule of 40 Score (Revenue Growth + Operating Margin %)

tooltip_definitions.U.S. Commercial Revenue: Revenue generated from domestic enterprise clients utilizing AIP and Foundry ($984.0M in Q3 2026, up +148% YoY, surpassing U.S. government revenue for the first time).
tooltip_definitions.U.S. Government Revenue: Defense, intelligence, and civilian agency contracts deploying Palantir Gotham, Maven Smart System, and TITAN ($953.0M in Q3 2026, up +96% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP): Palantir's flagship enterprise software activating generative AI, fine-tuned LLMs, and ontologies directly within operational enterprise workflows.
tooltip_definitions.Rule of 40 Score: The financial efficiency metric combining year-over-year revenue growth rate (96%) and adjusted operating margin (62%), reaching a hyper-growth record 158%.
tooltip_definitions.Remaining Deal Value (RDV): Total contract value remaining across active customer agreements ($6.517B in U.S. Commercial alone, surging +79% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Project Maven & TITAN: Flagship U.S. Department of Defense AI sensor-to-shooter targeting network and tactical battlefield ground station programs driving accelerating defense volume.
tooltip_definitions.AIP Bootcamps: Rapid prototyping workshops compressing sales cycles from months to days, converting Fortune 500 pilots into seven-figure enterprise production agreements.
tooltip_definitions.Adjusted Operating Income: Non-GAAP operating income excluding stock-based compensation and employer payroll taxes ($1,084.85M GAAP / $1.4B+ non-GAAP in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow ($1,204.57M) minus capital expenditures ($8.01M) and stock-based compensation ($318.89M), delivering an institutional $877.67M balance.
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Diluted EPS: Adjusted earnings per share excluding stock-based compensation expense and acquisition amortizations ($0.44 vs $0.41 consensus hurdle).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Net Income: Net profit attributable to common stockholders under U.S. GAAP ($1,128.01M in Q3 2026, surging +137.2% YoY vs $475.60M).
tooltip_definitions.Total GAAP Revenue: Consolidated net sales across Commercial and Government operations ($2,313.41M in Q3 2026, beating $2,180.44M Street consensus by +6.10%).
tooltip_definitions.Ontology-Based AI: Palantir's semantic digital twin representing enterprise data and physical operations, enabling AI models to act with deterministic business constraints.
tooltip_definitions.Sovereign AI Movement: National and enterprise drive to control sovereign computing infrastructure, data residency, and defense AI independent of foreign tech monopolies.
tooltip_definitions.Full-Year Guidance Raise: Upward revision of FY2026 revenue guidance to $8.530B-$8.534B (up from prior $7.9B consensus) and U.S. Commercial revenue to >$3.559B.
tooltip_definitions.Options Volatility Regime: Weekly ATM straddle implied a ±12.44% move ($23.45); stock printed -3.00% after-hours ($172.99), causing IV crush for premium sellers.
tooltip_definitions.Enterprise Value to Sales: Valuation multiple comparing enterprise value ($419.47B) against annualized forward revenue run-rate (~40.5x EV/Sales).
tooltip_definitions.Free Cash Flow Conversion: Adjusted free cash flow generated as a percentage of adjusted net income, exceeding 100% due to negative working capital and deferred revenue expansion.
